# MigraSutra AI

> Offline, deterministic, read-only migration audit CLI plus 20 portable agent skills (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot). Scans npm, Python, Docker and SQL migrations for upgrade risk, rehearses a manifest change in a temp directory, and writes JSON, Markdown and HTML reports with a conservative release verdict. Zero runtime dependencies, Apache-2.0, created by Vatsal Shah.

It never runs your tests, installs, scripts or migrations, so test status is always NOT_RUN and the best verdict is REVIEW_REQUIRED. SQL checks are heuristics.

## Quick start
- `npx migrasutra audit --root . --out report --target node:22`
- Output: report/audit.json, report/audit.md, report/audit.html
- Requires Node.js 22 or newer.
